vocab.definition: waste water containing organic matter and microbes.
settling out solids into sludge and effluent.
bacteria break down effluent using oxygen.

misconceptions.wrong: Sewage treatment is the same as making potable water.
misconceptions.right: It removes harmful matter before release, not for drinking.
Helpful bacteria are USED to break down waste.

misconceptions.wrong: Sludge is thrown away as useless.
misconceptions.right: Sludge can be digested to make biogas/fertiliser.

workedSteps: Screening — remove grit and large solids.
